cat > "$HOME/settle.py" <<'PYEOF'
import os, sys, time
leader, me = int(sys.argv[1]), os.getpid()
def stat(pid):
    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()
    return data[data.rindex(b")") + 2:].split()
guest = int(stat(leader)[1])
deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
while True:
    live = []
    for entry in os.listdir("/proc"):
        if not entry.isdigit() or int(entry) in (leader, me):
            continue
        try:
            fields = stat(entry)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
        if fields[0] != b"Z" and (int(fields[3]) == leader or int(fields[1]) == guest):
            live.append(entry)
    if not live or time.monotonic() > deadline:
        break
    time.sleep(0.05)
if live:
    print("unsettled-processes=%d" % len(live))
PYEOF
cat > "$HOME/echo.py" <<'PYEOF'
import socket, sys
server = socket.socket()
server.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
server.bind(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1])))
server.listen(1)
server.settimeout(10)
try:
    conn, _ = server.accept()
except socket.timeout:
    sys.exit(0)
open(sys.argv[2], "w").close()
conn.settimeout(5)
data = b""
try:
    while b"\n" not in data:
        chunk = conn.recv(4096)
        if not chunk:
            break
        data += chunk
    conn.sendall(b"echo:" + data)
except OSError:
    pass
conn.close()
PYEOF
cat > "$HOME/probe.py" <<'PYEOF'
import socket, sys
try:
    conn = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1])), timeout=5)
except OSError:
    print("connect-refused")
    sys.exit(0)
data = b""
try:
    conn.sendall(sys.argv[2].encode() + b"\n")
    while not data.endswith(b"\n"):
        chunk = conn.recv(4096)
        if not chunk:
            break
        data += chunk
except OSError:
    pass
sys.stdout.write(data.decode("utf-8", "replace") if data else "no-reply\n")

cat > "$HOME/hashcheck.py" <<'PYEOF'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, sys
key = open(sys.argv[2]).read().split()[1]
for line in open(sys.argv[1]):
    fields = line.split()
    if not fields or fields[0].startswith("#"):
        continue
    host, kind, blob = fields[0], fields[1], fields[2]
    match = "matches-host-key" if blob == key else "other-key"
    if host.startswith("|1|"):
        _, _, salt, mac = host.split("|")
        good = hmac.new(base64.b64decode(salt), sys.argv[3].encode(), hashlib.sha1).digest() == base64.b64decode(mac)

    else:
        print("plain", host, kind, match)

set -e
cat > "$HOME/settle.py" <<'PYEOF'
import os, sys, time
leader, me = int(sys.argv[1]), os.getpid()
def stat(pid):
    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()
    return data[data.rindex(b")") + 2:].split()
guest = int(stat(leader)[1])
deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
while True:
    live = []
    for entry in os.listdir("/proc"):
        if not entry.isdigit() or int(entry) in (leader, me):
            continue
        try:
            fields = stat(entry)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
        if fields[0] != b"Z" and (int(fields[3]) == leader or int(fields[1]) == guest):
            live.append(entry)
    if not live or time.monotonic() > deadline:
        break
    time.sleep(0.05)
if live:
    print("unsettled-processes=%d" % len(live))
PYEOF
cat > "$HOME/hold.py" <<'PYEOF'
import socket, sys, time
cmd = b"read -t 3 -u 9 9<>/tmp/parity-home/hold.fifo; echo late"
conn = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1])), timeout=5)
conn.sendall(b"BASHSSH1\ncmd-len %d\nstdin-len 0\n\n" % len(cmd) + cmd)
conn.settimeout(2.5)
data = b""
try:
    while True:
        chunk = conn.recv(4096)
        if not chunk:
            break
        data += chunk
except socket.timeout:
    print("session-still-open")
    sys.exit(0)
print("reply-received" if data else "closed-before-reply")

listening() { local _a l _r st _x
  while read -r _a l _r st _x; do [[ $l == 0100007F:$1 && $st == 0A ]] && return 0; done < /proc/net/tcp
  return 1; }
up() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
settle() { /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/settle.py" "$$"; }
stop() { kill "$1" 2>/dev/null; wait "$1" 2>/dev/null; echo server-stopped; }
finish() { local i s
  for ((i = 0; i < 100; i++)); do kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.05; done
  if kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null; then kill "$1"; wait "$1" 2>/dev/null; echo server-still-running; return; fi
  wait "$1"; s=$?
  if [ "$s" = 0 ]; then echo server-stopped; else echo "server-status=$s"; fi; }
export BASHSSHD_RUN_DIR="$HOME/run"
sshd keygen -f "$HOME/nk" >/dev/null || echo keygen-failed
sshd status >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo status-before-running || echo status-before-not-running
o=$(sshd sessions); [[ -z $o ]] && echo stale-not-listed || echo stale-listed
if [ -e "$HOME/run/sessions/stale-1" ]; then echo stale-record-kept; else echo stale-record-removed; fi
sshd run -a 127.0.0.1 -p 20553 -k "$HOME/nk" </dev/null 2>"$HOME/server.log" & srv=$!
up 5049 "$srv" || echo server-not-listening
if [[ $(<"$HOME/run/pid") == "$srv" ]]; then echo pidfile-is-own-server; else echo pidfile-other; fi
o=$(sshd status); s=$?; if [[ $s == 0 && $o == *"$srv"* ]]; then echo status-running-own-pid; else echo "status-running=$s"; fi
/usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/hold.py" 20553 > "$HOME/hold.out" & cl=$!
rows=; for ((i = 0; i < 100; i++)); do rows=$(sshd sessions); [[ -n $rows ]] && break; sleep 0.05; done
n=0; sid=; rest=; while read -r a b; do [[ -z $a ]] && continue; n=$((n + 1)); sid=$a; rest=$b; done <<< "$rows"
echo "sessions-listed=$n"; if [[ $rest == *native* ]]; then echo session-kind-native; else echo session-kind-other; fi
sshd kick "$sid"; echo "kick=$?"
wait "$cl"; printf '%s\n' "$(<"$HOME/hold.out")"
for ((i = 0; i < 100; i++)); do rows=$(sshd sessions); [[ -z $rows ]] && break; sleep 0.05; done
[[ -z $rows ]] && echo sessions-empty-after-kick || echo sessions-still-listed
sshd reload; echo "reload=$?"; sleep 0.2
sshd status >/dev/null && echo status-after-reload-running || echo status-after-reload-not-running
sshd stop; echo "stop=$?"
finish "$srv"
sshd status >/dev/null && echo status-after-stop-running || echo status-after-stop-not-running
if [ -e "$HOME/run/pid" ]; then echo pidfile-left; else echo pidfile-removed; fi
